notes.title: Brave updates ver 1.0.6
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce that The Little Brave is now playable in Spanish, Portuguese(Brazilian) and Chinese (Simplified).

Thank you very much for the positive feedback in these languages!

notes.title: Little Brave updates ver 1.0.5
notes.content: New update that fixes some mechanics. Collisions for some layers. Fonts have been updated to support more languages in further updates.

notes.title: Little Brave updates ver 1.0.4
notes.content: New update that fixes some mechanics. Heavy attack, shot animation, collisions for some layers. Added support for xbox controller features to meet full support steam conditions.

notes.title: Little Brave thanks
notes.content: Thank you so much, for your support and for sharing your thoughts about The Little Brave! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to me, and I am delighted to read the positive reviews. I'm going to keep working to improve the game!

notes.title: Little Brave updates ver 1.0.3
notes.content: New update that fixes some mechanics. Pull-up, enemy behavior, boss behavior, change music between locations, improve of auto aim and some other elements.

notes.title: Little Brave stream
notes.content: I invite you to The Little Brave gameplay broadcast  I'll be showing the first 20 minutes and the battle with the boss Grai. Please, let's all look together!

notes.title: Little Brave updates ver 1.0.2
notes.content: New update that fixes some mechanics. Melee weapon trail, pull-up, enemy behavior, change music between locations and some other elements.

notes.title: Little Brave updates ver 1.0.1
notes.content: New update fixing some mechanics. Pull-up, jump, camera smoothness when changing direction and some other elements.

notes.title: Little Brave request
notes.content:
I released my first game last week and received mostly positive feedback from around the world. Unfortunately Steam doesn't take them into rating, so the game looks underrated. 

I kindly ask those who bought the game and liked it to write a friendly review to support me on this difficult journey.

notes.title: The Little Brave release February 25th, 2025
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that the long-awaited release of The Little Brave is finally here! It's tomorrow, February 25th, on Steam. Be brave and get ready for the epic adventure with Keely!

In further updates after the release I plan to add support for several languages besides those already announced.

Support Keely on his adventure!

notes.title: Little Brave updates
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that a new gameplay and animated story teaser will soon be available on the page. Please stay tuned for further updates!

UPD: Together with the wonderfully talented team from [url=https://www.chaseacloud.com/]Chase a Cloud[/url], we have prepared for you a fascinating animated teaser revealing the story of the game's world

Add The Little Brave to your wishlist, support Keely on his adventure!

notes.title: Little Brave updates
notes.content:
It's been a long time since I posted news and announcements, but I did't stop working. Today I'd like to share the new screenshots on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724300/The_Little_Brave/]store page[/url] and welcome you to my blog on [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-little-brave/]IndieDB[/url]

There I write about the most interesting and important updates and my development progress. [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-little-brave/news/combat-features]In current article[/url] I wrote about combat features, please take a look!

notes.title: Play The Little Brave Demo at Going Rogue Festival
notes.content:
I would like to invite you to play the Demo of The Little Brave!

Test your courage in this demo adventure of The Little Brave. Find a way through an abandoned mine to the vault of one of the last pieces of gone magic. Overcome the challenge and defeat the mighty warden. Enjoy the wonderful original soundtrack by José Mora-Jiménez. 

Be Brave, play the Demo!

notes.title: The Little Brave Demo will be available on October 1st, 2021
notes.content:
I am so excited to announce that The Little Brave Demo will be available on October 1st at the Steam Next Fest Game Festival.

Test your courage in this demo adventure of The Little Brave. Find a way through an abandoned mine to the vault of one of the last pieces of gone magic. Overcome the challenge and defeat the mighty warden. Enjoy the wonderful original soundtrack by José Mora-Jiménez. 

Be Brave, play the Demo!

notes.title: THE LITTLE BRAVE took second place in round 22 on GDWC 2021
notes.content:
THE LITTLE BRAVE took second place in round 22 of the fan voting on [url=https://thegdwc.com/]Game Development World Championship[/url]. 

I am grateful for this amazing opportunity to participate in the competition. It was an intense struggle. 
I was honored to compete with such wonderful projects. 

Thanks to everyone for your support!
